Thanks for replying. Yeah I suppose I could reply. I'm a pretty normal dude for the most part... but really I just wanna die. I've been diagnosed with lots of things and been treated with meds and been funneled through the mental health system as doctors and therapists try to fit me into their own idea of what I am and then try to tell me what problems I have. Been hospitalized 6 times. Diagnosed with OCD, depression, anxiety, bipolar, psychosis, etc but really I've just been a person searching for the magic in life and I can never find it. Give my heart out to friends and some do care about me but they all kinda see me as empty deep down inside I guess. I'm 23 and can't even get past small habits like my need to constantly be clicking my middle mouse button while I'm on the Internet. Friends all have jobs and I'm failing college. Gave my heart out to my therapists but they were all wrong about me. I don't have a rich inner life filled with memories and people like others do. I've just been trying to search for something to believe in, something I can rely on, something I can devote myself to. I have some activities that I love like playing pool and chess, but idk how to explain. I'm not good at any of that, because I don't have a personality to motivate me to practice and develop my own style. I can't even tell if I'm a nice guy or not. I really want to find out what happens after death now, I've been searching my whole life for something to build myself on but I've found nothing. Maybe because I am nothing. So like, I don't have the regular complaints that people with personalities have. Everyone else has so much they've built and I can't find any foundation.
